recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中散布數個大型巨噬細胞（紅箭頭），高倍下其胞質內吞入多個完整的有核細胞（嗜中性球、淋巴球或紅血球前驅細胞）與紅血球碎片，即噬血現象（hemophagocytosis），在成人型 Still 病的脈絡下符合巨噬細胞活化症候群。
features: Low-power field with scattered large macrophages (red arrows) among hematopoietic cells
Macrophages with abundant vacuolated pale-blue cytoplasm and a round to oval eccentric nucleus
Multiple engulfed intact nucleated cells with dense pyknotic nuclei (neutrophils, lymphocytes and/or erythroid precursors) within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Phagocytosed red cells and pink-red cellular debris in the macrophage cytoplasm
No atypical lymphoid cells, blasts or intracellular organisms identified in these fields
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows scattered large macrophages distributed among hematopoietic elements. At high power, the macrophages have abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple engulfed intact nucleated cells, including granulocytes and small cells with dense nuclei consistent with lymphocytes or erythroid precursors, as well as red cells and debris. No atypical lymphoid cells, blasts or microorganisms are identified. Findings represent hemophagocytosis and, in a patient with adult-onset Still's disease and compatible laboratory findings (ferritin, cytopenias, triglycerides), are consistent with macrophage activation syndrome, a secondary form of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Lymphoma-associated HLH shows accompanying atypical lymphoid cells (e.g. CD30+ or EBV+ T/NK cells) on smear or biopsy, which are absent here.
Intracellular organisms such as Leishmania amastigotes or Histoplasma yeasts, or viral PCR positivity, identify infectious triggers.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific phagocytosis after transfusion, chemotherapy or sepsis
ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytic macrophages are nonspecific, so HLH/MAS requires the clinical-laboratory criteria (HLH-2004 or MAS classification criteria).
Emperipolesis involves intact cells passing through megakaryocyte cytoplasm with a lobulated megakaryocyte nucleus, not destruction within a macrophage vacuole.
